title: chore: bump .objectui-sha to e885db38d (Studio source-page editor fix)
body:
Bumps the vendored @objectstack/console pin so the served console includes the **Studio source-page editor** (objectui #2109): editing a `kind:'html'`/`'react'` page now shows a code editor + live preview instead of crashing on the design canvas. Range since previous pin (998c5b3c9 -> e885db38d): #2106 (data-table inline-edit error surfacing) + #2109 (Studio fix). build-console.sh rebuilds at release time.
